headline: Devastating Floods in Nepal Cause Power Crisis; Neighbour May Seek India's Help
summary: Floods caused by a glacier collapse in the Himalayan region between Nepal and Tibet damaged about 360 MW of capacity, mostly hydropower plants. A 25 MW solar plant and projects totalling 390 MW under construction were also affected.
why: Hydropower is a major electricity source for Nepal, and damage to generation capacity affects power supply and export revenue from electricity sales.
